items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: except them few fellows was trying to hold up the Excelsis' name during the connoisseur time.

ctx.x: And the prices you usually received was in around $2 all the way to $2.15, $2.30 quite often. Sometimes $2.55. Occasionally you'd get as much as $4.

I didn't drop it. We had $2.50 or $3.00 for an hour. The musicians and I were getting $10, $12, $15 for them. Yeah, that's right. They'd only go out now. Most of us are orchestras around here now. There's no brass bands around there except them few fellows was trying to hold up the Excelsis' name during the connoisseur time. They'd get some work. But otherwise, there's all orchestras around here now. And them fellows that get $10, $12, $15 every time they go out and play. They'd play sometime, extra hours at…
